name: Grand Canyon National Park
state_or_region: Arizona (Grand Canyon National Park — South Rim, North Rim, Inner Canyon & Marble Canyon)
agency: National Park Service, USGS 3DEP & OpenStreetMap Contributors
summary: The whole canyon from Lees Ferry and Marble Canyon to the Grand Wash Cliffs: South and North Rim, the Bright Angel, Kaibab and Grandview corridors, Phantom Ranch and the remote inner-canyon routes. Extreme heat below the rim — a rim-to-river day hike is not recommended.
emergency_contact: Grand Canyon NP emergency: 911 (from park phones) / (928) 638-7805
